brand_notes: ATC (Stroud, UK): pro-monitor heritage, all drivers in-house (SL "super linear" mid/bass, SH25-76 tweeter), sealed cabinets, low sensitivity (84-85 dB), 6-year warranty, rated 8 ohm but measured minima 5.25-5.6 ohm (avmentor-atc-scm19, stereophile-atc-scm7). Entry Series passive: SCM7 $1,749, SCM11, SCM19 ~$3,750-4,200; Classic SCM20PSL $6,499. Entry-series models sold via US dealers (Sound Approach, The Music Room, Music Direct). No QC complaints found.
takeaways: Only Tier-B data: AVMentor quasi-anechoic, ~83 dB sens, 5.6 Ω min @150 Hz, f3 52 Hz, wide even horizontal dispersion
Critics (TAS, SoundStage, Stereo Times) praise neutrality, dynamics, tight sealed bass; all warn it needs a strong amp
No Klippel/spinorama, no distortion/max SPL data
Sensitivity 2 dB below ATC claim; flagged below-iec on 5.6 Ω
Reviews cover earlier SCM19 generations; price spread $3,749-$4,199
conflicts: Bass f6 40 Hz (AVMentor) vs 54 Hz claimed
